title: The Listening Winter
author: Rafael Ishikawa
blurb: Xanthe Joubert, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the harvest moon rises.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
